reading.title: Our Class Rules
reading.purpose: Hear how rules help our class listen, share, and stay safe.
paras: Our class has rules. Rules help everyone. We listen when a friend talks. We share the markers and the books.
When the bell rings, we get ready. We walk together to the playground. We hold the rail, and we stay safe.

qs.q: We share the markers. What do we do?
qs.why: To share means to give some to others, so everyone gets a turn.

qs.q: We hold the rail. Which word tells why?
qs.why: We hold the rail so we are not hurt. That is staying safe.
Every sentence tells a rule that helps our class.
